# Docs

This folder holds the documents of this project. It is the `docs/` folder inside the project's folder.

- Put Markdown (`.md`) files here and they appear in the Docs list in Agent Board. You can organize them in folders. Create, rename and delete files here in the folder; the Docs dialog does not do that.
- Use "Docs" in the header to open a file, edit it in place and save it. The dialog stays open after saving.
- If the file changed elsewhere since you opened it, the save is refused and your edits stay on screen. Choose "Reload the latest" to discard them, or "Overwrite with mine" to save over the other change.
- Deleting the project also deletes this `docs/` folder. Move any file you want to keep somewhere else first.
